threads.title: Was Becker a great player who could have won even more?
threads.body: Boris was one of the best players I’ve ever seen and certainly one of the most complete, with a full arsenal of shots—serve, volley, smash, forehand, and backhand. In every match (except on red clay), he always gave me the impression of being the best player—and thus the favorite—but despite his many victories, I felt at the time that he should have won and dominated even more. threads.title: Do You Want to be truly Happy or truly Free?
threads.body: Truly happy means being content and at peace with your life, even when life isn’t perfect. Truly free means having the courage and ability to live according to your own values without being controlled by fear, expectations, or other people’s approval. In short, happiness is peace with your life; freedom is ownership of your life. Given the above, I will always choose to be truly free. How about you?

threads.title: Zverev's 2 slam year validates Djokovic's 2025 slam level.
threads.body: Recall that Djokovic made 4 SFs in 2025 including a 4 set QF victory over current RG and US Open champ Zverev. Djokovic won the last 3 sets 6-3 6-2 6-4, making Zverev look like one dimensional chump. It's simply further validation of Djokovic's incredible slam level in 2025, not far from his 21-23 level, which was enough to convincingly beat a multi-slam winner. It's just too bad it wasn't enough to beat ATGs.
